purpose: autonomous verification and failure-preserving observation of previously proposed FORMIC draft pull requests

sources.checkRuns: GitHub check-runs API on exact PR head SHA
sources.commitStatuses: GitHub statuses API on exact PR head SHA
sources.prHistory: All PR states on FORMIC branch

suppression.afterFailedChecks: HOLD, no automatic retry or force push
suppression.afterClosedPullRequest: HOLD, no recreation under same FORMIC repair branch
suppression.history: Each scheduled run emits a separate immutable GitHub Actions artifact for the configured retention; does not change repository source
